# Word behind — Style Prompt

> A talking head whose room turns into a soft pastel set. The real background washes to a lavender gradient (the room still ghosts through), one giant white word drops in behind the speaker's head so the head overlaps it, short spoken lines sit in small white pills on the chest, and the old way appears as a cream serif word on the real footage that a red hand-drawn line crosses out. It ends on a white profile card that rises from the bottom while a cursor taps Ikuti and it flips to Mengikuti. Vertical, calm, creator-made, one idea per word.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

1. **The person stays in front.** Every big word is behind the speaker: footage, then the lavender wash, then the word, then the cutout of the person, then pills and cards. The head always overlaps the bottom of the word.
2. **One word carries the beat.** Each beat has one giant word (a topic, a time, a name), never a sentence. The spoken sentence is a 2–4 word pill.
3. **Two rooms.** Lavender means "the new way / the point"; the untouched real room means "the old way / the problem", and that is where the cream serif word gets struck out.
4. **Social proof as UI.** The ending is a generic profile card (avatar cut from the speaker's own face, name, handle, a role in the main colour, Ikuti) that gets followed.

Not a kinetic-type film (one word per beat, it drops once and holds). Not a green-screen composite (the room ghosts through the wash, it is the same room). Not a copy of any app: the card is plain, no logos, no app chrome.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Footage**: the user's talking head from `list_media` as a full-frame `<video>` (`assets/media/upl_….mp4`), reframed to 9:16 with the face at about x 540, y 760 and the head about 290 px tall (craft `reframe.md`). The example paints a stand-in once in SVG (a warm living room with a shelf and a floor lamp, a seated person) and only moves it: a head sway of ±1.8°, a 5 px breath, blinks, a mouth that opens on the spoken stretches.
- **The cutout**: for the word to sit behind the person, ask `make_cutout` for each stretch with a word (≤ 6 s each) and lay `assets/media/cut_….webm` over the word with the cutoutTiming rule (`data-start = S + max(0, from − M)`, `data-media-start = max(0, M − from)`, `data-duration = min(to, M + D) − max(from, M)`). Without a cutout, put the word above the head instead, never across the face.
- **Lavender wash**: one full-frame layer at 86 % opacity: a 166° gradient from `--utama` (top left) through 55 % `--utama` to `--latar` (bottom right), so the room's shapes ghost through at 14 %. It fades in or out in 0.2 s, linear, on the beat's first frame.
- **Giant word**: flat, white, with one soft drop shadow (0 12 px 24 px, 24 % black). No outline, no gradient.
- **Cream serif word**: flat cream (`--krem`) with a 35 % shadow, revealed left to right by a clip; the strike is a 13.5 px round-capped red line with a slight downward slope across the word (it falls 5 % of the word's height) and a small wobble, drawn like a marker.
- **Pills and card**: `--latar-2` with a soft shadow (0 8–10 px 28–36 px); the card is 86 % of the width, 15 % of the width tall, corners 30 % of its height (930 × 162, radius 49 at 1080 px).
- **Cursor**: a white arrow with a black outline, 65 × 94 px.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--utama` is the room's colour: the lavender of the wash (the example's #b3abf7). A brand turns the room its own hue; the wash still lets the real room through.
- `--teks-di-utama` is the giant word: white on a mid lavender, dark ink on a pale yellow brand. Never colour the giant word with the brand's main colour.
- `--latar` is the pale end of the wash and the page; `--latar-2` the pills and the card; `--teks` their ink, `--teks-redup` the handle and Mengikuti.
- `--utama-di-latar` is the violet of key words in pills, the role on the card and the Ikuti button (the example's #7c5cff).
- Fixed in every brand: the cream serif word (`--krem`) and the red strike (`--coret`), because they sit on the untouched real footage; the white cursor; the shadow black; the footage's own colours (`--f-*`).

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the giant word: weight 800, uppercase, letter-spacing −0.02em, line-height 1, sized so the word fills 96 % of the width: 270 px for five letters, about 196 px for eight. The example uses Inter 800; Archivo Black, Poppins 800 or Oswald 700 (condensed, for longer words) also suit.
- The struck word is a display serif: Playfair Display 700, uppercase, 300 px (90 % of the width at most). Keep it serif in every brand: the contrast between the old serif and the new sans is the point.
- `--font-isi` carries the pills (800, 46 px), the card's name (800, 36 px), handle (600, 24 px) and the button (800, 32 px).
- One word per giant word; numbers with their unit ("10 MENIT"). Max about 9 characters at full width; longer, use a shorter synonym.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Word drop**: from 6 % of the frame height above (−115 px) to rest in 0.45 s, ease-out cubic (`power3.out`), opacity in over the first 0.15 s; out with a 0.2 s fade at the end of its beat. It starts 0.05 s into the beat.
- **Room wash**: 0.2 s linear, at the beat's first frame.
- **Serif reveal**: a left-to-right clip over 0.35 s `power3.out`, 0.05 s into the beat; the strike starts 0.6 s after the word (0.65 s into the beat) and draws in 0.18 s `power3.out`.
- **Pills**: pop from 0.86 to 1 in 0.25 s `back.out(2)`, 0.15–0.2 s into the beat; change in place every 1.5–2 s; out in 0.12 s.
- **Card**: rises from 20 % of the frame height below (+384 px) in 0.35 s `power3.out`, 0.15 s into the beat, opacity in 0.12 s. The cursor enters from the bottom-right corner at 0.25 s and glides to the button with `power2.inOut`, arriving 0.05 s before the click; the click lands at 50–60 % of the beat: the cursor scales to 0.85 for 0.15 s, Ikuti becomes Mengikuti, the card squeezes 6 % and back over 0.25 s. Then everything holds ≥ 2 s.
- **Beats**: 2.5–4.5 s each; the hook word is on screen by 0.2 s.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Static frame, the speaker breathes | a calm creator talking to you | every beat (the look never zooms) |
| Wash to lavender (0.2 s) | "here is the point", the new way | hooks, facts, steps, offers, the ending |
| Wash back to the real room (0.2 s) | "this is how it was" | problems, the old option in a compare |
| Word drops behind the head | the topic lands | the hook, a step, a number, a name |
| Card rises from below | someone to follow, proof | the call to action, a testimonial |

## 7. Native moves

- **Word behind the head.** The room washes lavender and one giant word drops behind the speaker; the head overlaps its bottom. *Fits content like:* a cooking creator's "RESEP"; a shop's "PROMO"; a teacher's "RUMUS"; a storyteller's "RAHASIA"; a podcaster's "TAMU".
- **Struck serif.** The room turns real again, the old way appears as a huge cream serif word, a red marker line crosses it out. *Fits content like:* "2 JAM" before "10 MENIT"; a shop's old price; "HAFALAN" in a study tip; "MALU" in a confidence story.
- **Time as the word.** The number and unit as the giant word, the sentence in a pill. *Fits content like:* "10 MENIT"; "3 BAHAN"; "Rp15RB"; "7 HARI".
- **Followed card.** A white profile card rises, a cursor taps Ikuti, it becomes Mengikuti. *Fits content like:* a creator's own account; a shop's account; a class's channel; the character of a story the viewer should follow.
- **Pill under the chin.** The spoken line in a white pill on the chest, one violet key word. *Fits content like:* "Masak enak, 10 menit"; "Ongkir gratis hari ini"; "Cuma butuh pensil"; "Dia belum tahu".

## 8. Pitfalls

- **A word across the face**: without a cutout the word must end above the hair; with one, check that the cutout's edge hides the word cleanly where hair is thin.
- **Long words**: past 9 characters the word shrinks and stops feeling giant; pick a shorter word.
- **The struck word on lavender**: cream on a pale wash does not read; the struck word belongs to the real room.
- **A pale brand**: the word turns dark ink; that is correct. Never force white.
- **Card over the hands or a product**: the card covers the lower 15 %; keep anything shown by hand above y 1500.
- **Captions on everything**: one pill per 1.5–2 s, 2–4 words; with a word-timed transcript (`inspect_media` words {text, start, end}) start each pill at its first word's `start` minus 0.05 s and end it at the last word's `end`. Fix names and prices with the user.
- **Performance**: the wash is one static gradient layer; only opacity moves. The stand-in is drawn once; only transforms and one attribute change per frame.

## Measured from the references

Read from the source effect code at 1080 × 1920: wash gradient from rgb(0.70, 0.67, 0.97) to rgb(0.93, 0.90, 1.0) along 0.8 × y + 0.2 × x, the room's luminance kept at 0.86 + 0.22 × lum; the wash ramps in 0.2 s. Giant word fit to 96 % of the width, shadow blur 24, offset 12, alpha 60/255; its centre at max(0.45 × its height, face y − 1.2 × face width); drop 6 % of the height over 0.45 s. Card 0.86 W × 0.15 W, radius 0.3 h, centre at 86.5 % of the height, rises 0.2 H over 0.35 s from 0.15 s; avatar 0.64 h; name 0.22 h; handle 0.15 h; button 0.2 h; click at 0.6 × the effect's length, squeeze 6 % over 0.25 s; cursor 0.06 W. Struck word: serif at 0.28 W, fit to 0.9 W, reveal 0.35 s, strike at 0.6 s over 0.18 s, line width W / 80, across 92 % of the word.

# Word behind: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.5, medium 3.5, long 4.5.

## hook

- en: the room washes lavender, the topic word drops in huge behind the speaker's head, one short spoken line in a white pill
- id: ruang jadi lavender, kata topik jatuh besar di belakang kepala pembicara, satu kalimat pendek di pil putih

## problem

- en: the room turns back to the real footage; the old way as a cream serif word behind the head, crossed out by a red hand line
- id: ruang kembali ke rekaman asli; cara lama jadi kata serif krem di belakang kepala, lalu dicoret garis merah tangan

## fact

- en: lavender room, the fact's key word or number huge behind the head, the sentence in two short pills
- id: ruang lavender, kata atau angka kunci fakta besar di belakang kepala, kalimatnya di dua pil pendek

## step

- en: one giant word per step behind the head (the action or the time it takes), each step its own drop
- id: satu kata raksasa per langkah di belakang kepala (tindakan atau lamanya), tiap langkah jatuh sendiri

## compare

- en: the old option as a struck cream serif word on real footage, then lavender and the new one as a giant word
- id: pilihan lama jadi kata serif krem yang dicoret di rekaman asli, lalu lavender dan yang baru jadi kata raksasa

## number

- en: the number alone as the giant word behind the head, its unit in the white pill below
- id: angkanya sendiri jadi kata raksasa di belakang kepala, satuannya di pil putih di bawah

## proof

- en: the result as the giant word, the profile card of the person or shop who got it rises at the bottom
- id: hasilnya jadi kata raksasa, kartu profil orang atau toko yang mendapatkannya naik di bawah

## offer

- en: the product name huge behind the head, the price in the white pill
- id: nama produk besar di belakang kepala, harganya di pil putih

## cta

- en: the name word behind the head, a white profile card rises, a cursor taps Ikuti and it turns Mengikuti, held 2 s
- id: kata nama di belakang kepala, kartu profil putih naik, kursor mengetuk Ikuti lalu jadi Mengikuti, diam 2 dtk

## payoff

- en: back to the hook's word behind the head, now the answer, held 2 s on lavender
- id: kembali ke kata pembuka di belakang kepala, kini sebagai jawaban, diam 2 dtk di lavender

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Kata di belakang</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Playfair Display"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama.
         Ruang lavender = gradasi --utama ke --latar di atas rekaman; kata raksasa memakai --teks-di-utama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #ede6ff; --latar-2: #ffffff; --utama: #b3abf7; --aksen: #ee2222;
        --teks: #141416; --teks-redup: #75757f; --teks-di-utama: #ffffff; --teks-di-aksen: #ffffff;
        --utama-di-latar: #7c5cff; --aksen-di-latar: #d61c1c;
        --font-judul: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Milik gaya: kata serif krem dan garis coret merah selalu di atas rekaman asli, jadi tetap. */
        --krem: #fdf6c8; --coret: #ee2222; --bayang: #000000; --kursor: #ffffff; --kursor-garis: #000000;
        /* Rekaman pengganti (ruang tamu hangat dan orangnya): warna footage, tidak ikut brand. */
        --f-dinding: #e7d3b6; --f-dinding2: #b99b78; --f-lampu: #fff1cf; --f-kap: #f6e6c4; --f-kayu: #6b4a33;
        --f-buku1: #8c3b2e; --f-buku2: #2f5b6b; --f-buku3: #d9b24c; --f-sofa: #9a9a95; --f-sofa2: #7d7d78;
        --f-kulit: #c98d68; --f-kulit2: #a8704f; --f-kulit3: #e2ab86; --f-rambut: #2a1b14; --f-baju: #2c4a40;
        --f-baju2: #213a32; --f-jins: #3f5675; --f-mata: #24160f; --f-putih: #f4eee8; --f-bibir: #a65a4c; --f-mulut: #4a1d18;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .lapis { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1080px; height: 1920px; }
      /* Urutan lapis: rekaman (0) → ruang lavender (1) → kata di belakang (2) → orang/cutout (3) → kartu dan teks (4). */
      #ruang { z-index: 0; }
      #lav { z-index: 1; background: linear-gradient(166deg, var(--utama) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 55%, var(--latar)) 45%, var(--latar) 100%); opacity: 0.86; }
      #orang { z-index: 3; }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; visibility: hidden; }
      #s1 { visibility: visible; }
      .kata { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 1080px; z-index: 2; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800;
        text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1; color: var(--teks-di-utama); opacity: 0;
        text-shadow: 0 12px 24px color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayang) 24%, transparent); }
      .serif { position: absolute; left: 540px; z-index: 2; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; font-family: "Playfair Display", serif; font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 300px; line-height: 1; color: var(--krem); text-shadow: 0 8px 20px color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayang) 35%, transparent); clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); }
      .gores { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 1080px; height: 1920px; z-index: 2; overflow: visible; }
      .gores path { fill: none; stroke: var(--coret); stroke-width: 13.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-dasharray: 1; stroke-dashoffset: 1; }
      /* Teks bicara: pil putih kecil di dada, satu potongan 2-4 kata. */
      .ucap { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 1080px; top: 1392px; z-index: 4; }
      .ucap span { position: absolute; left: 540px; top: 0; padding: 14px 30px 16px; border-radius: 26px; background: var(--latar-2); color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi);
        font-weight: 800; font-size: 46px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; white-space: nowrap; opacity: 0; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -8px color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayang) 40%, transparent); }
      .ucap b { color: var(--utama-di-latar); font-weight: 800; }
      /* Kartu profil yang diikuti: 86 % lebar, tinggi 0,15 lebar, sudut 0,3 tinggi. */
      .kartu { position: absolute; left: 75px; top: 1580px; width: 930px; height: 162px; border-radius: 49px; background: var(--latar-2); z-index: 4; opacity: 0;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 36px color-mix(in oklab, var(--bayang) 35%, transparent); }
      .kartu svg { position: absolute; left: 29px; top: 29px; width: 104px; height: 104px; border-radius: 52px; }
      .nama { position: absolute; left: 159px; top: 39px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 36px; color: var(--teks); white-space: nowrap; }
      .akun { position: absolute; left: 159px; top: 92px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 24px; color: var(--teks-redup); white-space: nowrap; }
      .akun b { color: var(--utama-di-latar); font-weight: 600; }
      .ikuti { position: absolute; right: 36px; top: 61px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 32px; white-space: nowrap; text-align: right; }
      .ikuti span { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; }
      .kursor { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 65px; height: 94px; z-index: 5; overflow: visible; opacity: 0; }
      .kursor path { fill: var(--kursor); stroke: var(--kursor-garis); stroke-width: 4.6; stroke-linejoin: round; }
      /* Orang pengganti */
      .k1 { fill: url(#kulit); } .k2 { fill: var(--f-kulit2); } .rb { fill: var(--f-rambut); } .bj { fill: var(--f-baju); } .bj2 { fill: var(--f-baju2); } .jn { fill: var(--f-jins); }
      .alis { fill: none; stroke: var(--f-rambut); stroke-width: 9; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .mt { fill: var(--f-putih); } .iris { fill: var(--f-mata); } .hidung { fill: none; stroke: var(--f-kulit2); stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; }
      .mulut { fill: var(--f-mulut); stroke: var(--f-bibir); stroke-width: 10; }
      .mata { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 50%; }
    </style>
  </head>

      const ucap = (sc, times, t1) => $$(`${sc} .ucap span`).forEach((el, i) => {

        tl.fromTo(el, { opacity: 0, scale: 0.86 }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.25, ease: "back.out(2)" }, times[i]);
        tl.to(el, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.12, ease: "none" }, (times[i + 1] ?? t1) - 0.12);
      });
      [1, 2, 3].forEach(cut);
      // 1. Hook: ruang lavender, kata di belakang kepala.
      kata("#k1", 0.05, S[1]);
      ucap("#s1", [0.2], S[1]);
      // 2. Masalah: ruang kembali asli 0,2 dtk; kata serif krem terbuka kiri → kanan 0,35 dtk, lalu dicoret merah 0,18 dtk.
      tl.to("#lav", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.2, ease: "none" }, S[1]);
      tl.to("#w2", { clipPath: "inset(0 0% 0 0)", duration: 0.35, ease: "power3.out" }, S[1] + 0.05);
      gsap.set("#w2", { xPercent: -50 });
      const TW = 1010, x0 = 960 - TW * 0.46, x1 = 960 + TW * 0.46, cy = 30 + 290; // TW = lebar kata serif
      $("#g2").setAttribute("d", Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => { const u = i / 39;
        return `${i ? "L" : "M"}${(x0 + (x1 - x0) * u).toFixed(1)} ${(cy + 16 - u * 20 + Math.sin(u * 19) * 3).toFixed(1)}`; }).join(" "));
      tl.to("#g2", { strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: 0.18, ease: "power3.out" }, S[1] + 0.65);
      tl.to(["#w2", "#g2"], { opacity: 0, duration: 0.2, ease: "none" }, S[2] - 0.2);
      ucap("#s2", [S[1] + 0.15], S[2]);
      // 3. Langkah: lavender kembali, kata baru jatuh.
      tl.to("#lav", { opacity: 0.86, duration: 0.2, ease: "none" }, S[2]);
      kata("#k3", S[2] + 0.05, S[3]);
      ucap("#s3", [S[2] + 0.2, S[2] + 1.9], S[3]);
      // 4. Ajakan: kartu profil naik 0,35 dtk, kursor datang, klik di 60 % adegan → Mengikuti, kartu menekan 6 %.
      tl.fromTo("#k4", { y: -65 }, { y: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "power3.out" }, S[3] + 0.05);
      tl.to("#k4", { opacity: 1, duration: 0.15, ease: "none" }, S[3] + 0.05);
      tl.fromTo("#kartu", { y: 216 }, { y: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: "power3.out" }, S[3] + 0.15);
      tl.to("#kartu", { opacity: 1, duration: 0.12, ease: "none" }, S[3] + 0.15);
      const at = S[3] + 2.0;
      tl.fromTo("#kursor", { x: 1940, y: 1100 }, { x: 1380, y: 990, duration: at - 0.05 - (S[3] + 0.25), ease: "power2.inOut" }, S[3] + 0.25);
      tl.to("#kursor", { opacity: 1, duration: 0.1, ease: "none" }, S[3] + 0.25);
      tl.to("#kursor", { scale: 0.85, duration: 0.05, ease: "none", transformOrigin: "0% 0%" }, at);
      tl.to("#kursor", { scale: 1, duration: 0.1, ease: "power2.out" }, at + 0.15);
      tl.set("#b1", { opacity: 0 }, at); tl.set("#b2", { opacity: 1 }, at);
      tl.to("#kartu", { scale: 0.94, duration: 0.125, ease: "sine.out" }, at);
      tl.to("#kartu", { scale: 1, duration: 0.125, ease: "sine.in" }, at + 0.125);
      // Rekaman pengganti hidup: kepala goyang pelan, kedip, mulut mengikuti bicara (proksi satu jalur).
      const mulut = $("#mulut"), kepala = $("#kepala"), mata = $$(".mata"), org = $("#org");
      const BICARA = [[0.2, 3.3], [3.8, 7.1], [7.6, 10.7], [11.2, 12.8], [13.2, 14.6]], KEDIP = [1.3, 4.6, 6.9, 9.8, 12.2, 14.4];
      const hidup = { t: 0 };
      tl.to(hidup, { t: 15, duration: 15, ease: "none", onUpdate: () => {

        org.setAttribute("transform", `translate(0 ${(5 * Math.sin(t * 2.1)).toFixed(1)})`);
      } }, 0);
